title: Efficiently Scaling LLM Reasoning with Certaindex
authors: Yichao Fu; Junda Chen; Siqi Zhu; Zheyu Fu; Zhongdongming Dai; Yonghao Zhuang; Yian Ma; Aurick Qiao; Tajana Rosing; Ion Stoica; Hao Zhang
affiliations: UCSD, Tsinghua University, Carnegie Mellon University, Snowflake, UC Berkeley
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Test-time reasoning algorithms (CoT, self-consistency, MCTS, REBASE) wastefully spend tokens long after the model's intermediate answer has stabilised, with reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 producing about 3x more tokens than necessary on tasks such as AMC23. Existing serving stacks lack a runtime signal to detect this answer stabilisation and terminate early, leaving substantial token budget unrecovered.
problem_statement.zh: Test-time reasoning 演算法（CoT、self-consistency、MCTS、REBASE）在模型的中間答案已穩定後仍持續花費 tokens，DeepSeek-R1 等 reasoning model 在 AMC23 等任務上產生的 tokens 數量約為實際需要的 3x。現有 serving stack 缺乏 runtime 信號偵測此答案穩定狀態並提前終止，因此大量 token 預算被浪費。

key_innovation.en: Introduces certaindex, an algorithm-agnostic stability metric computed from semantic entropy across reasoning paths (for SC/MCTS/REBASE) or from reward-model scores (for MCTS/REBASE). Builds Dynasor, a reasoning-aware serving layer on top of SGLang that uses certaindex for (i) certaindex-based intra-program scheduling with early exit, (ii) gang scheduling for requests in the same reasoning program, and (iii) program-aware approximate SJF inter-program scheduling with finish-time fairness.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 certaindex：一個與演算法無關的穩定性指標，對 SC、MCTS、REBASE 由 reasoning paths 的 semantic entropy 計算，對含 reward model 的 MCTS、REBASE 則直接取 reward 分數。基於 certaindex 在 SGLang 之上建構 Dynasor，提供三項機制：(i) certaindex 驅動的 intra-program scheduler 支援 early exit；(ii) 同 reasoning program 內請求的 gang scheduling；(iii) program-aware 的近似 SJF inter-program scheduler，並以 finish-time fairness 防止飢餓。

key_improvements.en: Up to 50% compute savings at equal accuracy in batch inference (CoT, SC, MCTS, REBASE). Up to 3.3x higher sustainable request rate under P90 deadline attainment vs SGLang and Parrot in online serving; 4.7x tighter SLOs at the same attainment rate. Token savings of 11-29% across DeepSeek-Qwen-distilled 7B/14B/32B on AIME24, AMC23, MATH500; for the top 1% of problems, 53% (AIME) and 81% (MATH500) token reduction. DeepSeek-R1 saves 12% tokens on AIME and 24% on AMC.
key_improvements.zh: 在 batch inference (CoT、SC、MCTS、REBASE) 上以相同精度節省最多 50% 計算。Online serving 下相對 SGLang 與 Parrot 將可支撐的 request rate 提升最多 3.3x（P90 deadline attainment 標準），或在相同 attainment 下將 SLO 收緊 4.7x。DeepSeek-Qwen-distilled 7B/14B/32B 在 AIME24、AMC23、MATH500 上節省 11-29% tokens；最難的 top 1% 問題則達 53%（AIME）與 81%（MATH500）的 token 節省。DeepSeek-R1 在 AIME 節省 12% tokens、AMC 節省 24%。

gpu_count: 2x A100 80GB for MCTS/REBASE (LLM + reward model); 1x A100 80GB for SC
reported_accuracy: Certaindex H achieves Pearson correlation of 0.68 and Kendall's Tau of 0.61 with ground-truth required steps, vs 0.40/0.35 for path length and 0.40/0.34 for mean log-probability entropy
models_validated: DeepSeek-Qwen-Distilled 7B/14B/32B, DeepSeek-R1, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama2-7B, Llemma-7B, Llemma-34B, Skywork-7B, QwQ, Gemma, Phi
validation_workloads: AIME24, AMC23, MATH500, GSM8K, ASDiv, LiveCodeBench, GAME24

scope_assumptions.en: Targets reasoning-program workloads where intermediate answers can be probed; does not yet integrate with advanced serving techniques such as PD-disaggregation or chunked-prefill. Thresholds are profiler-calibrated per (algorithm, dataset, LLM) and may need recalibration under data distribution shifts. Probe-in-the-middle inserts a prompt to force an interim answer; correctness depends on the model honoring this prompt. Acknowledges potential side-channel and bias risks in multi-tenant settings.
scope_assumptions.zh: 鎖定可在中途探測答案的 reasoning-program workload；尚未整合 PD-disaggregation、chunked-prefill 等進階 serving 技術。Threshold 為 profiler 校準後與 (algorithm, dataset, LLM) 綁定，當資料分佈漂移時可能需重新校準。Probe-in-the-middle 透過插入特定 prompt 強制模型給出中間答案，其有效性依賴模型對該 prompt 的響應。論文亦提示在多租戶情境下可能存在側通道與偏差風險。
